title: Segway is fun to explore
text: Nice way to see a lot of Barcelona. Good guide who knew a lot to tell. You will also go to places that are not in the guidebooks. A Segway is fine to drive
author: mzwan1961

title: Segways are fun, and Natasha was a great guide on a well-designed tour
text: My wife, young adult son and I had the pleasure of doing the Barcelona Grand Segway tour with Natasha.  We had a great time and Natasha was a terrific guide.  The tour was 2 hours and gave us a great sense of some of the more beautiful areas in Barcelona that were impacted by two significant events that helped shape the more modern city of Barcelona:  The world fair (universal expedition) hosted in Barcelona in 1888, and the Olympics in 1992. author: theyoussefs

title: Great day with Natasha
text: Our guide Natasha. She was so personable and so knowledgeable.  It was so much fun.  We saw parts of Barcelona we had never saw before although we’ve been here several times.  Learning about the history of Barcelona landmarks, the Olympic village, and the history of Catalonia was the perfect day. Thank you Natasha for making our day perfect.
author: ADRIENNE_P

title: Great tour!
text:
It was a really nice time, tour went great! I was afraid a little because it was my first time on Segway but our guide Kadyr taught us, helped to feel more confident and told a lot of interesting things about Barcelona! We drove near beautiful places and even fed parrots :) 

Really recommend)
author: MariaN3501

title: Loved it!
text: Segway tour is a good thing to do in Barcelona. Booked a  tour one day before arriving, the staff is very friendly and funny.
author: J9326TWlukeg

title: Excellent Segway tour!
text: We had a really nice time with Kadyr as our guide on the Segway tour. He showed us places that you wouldn't normally expect when you think of Barcelona. Highly recommended if you are in Barcelona. Thanks to our guide Kadyr, he took the time to tell us about the different places, and also to answer our questions and take photos. Feeding the parakeets from our hand was also great. And of course our guide paid close attention to our safety during the segway tour. So just do it!
author: 172amarnathr

title: Fantastic way to start your Barcelona vacation!
text: Loved this tour. Natasha gave us great info about all our stops, but also gave us time to stop and explore. She was amazing!
